name: The Westin Resort & Spa Ubud, Bali
short_description: A wellness-focused Westin in Singakerta, on Ubud's outskirts, with jungle-view rooms, a Heavenly Spa, and a shuttle to central Ubud and the Monkey Forest.
ai_summary: The Westin Resort & Spa Ubud, Bali sits in Singakerta on Ubud's outskirts, positioned as a small, quiet resort surrounded by jungle scenery rather than one of the larger beach-area Bonvoy properties. Rated 4 of 5 across roughly 1,320 TripAdvisor reviews and ranked fourth of 13 hotels in Singakerta, it leans into Westin's wellness brand identity with a Heavenly Spa in a dedicated building offering some open-air treatment rooms, plus morning yoga and stretch sessions, cycling, and running programs. Guest feedback consistently praises jungle-view rooms (with views extending even to some bathrooms), a breakfast spread at Tabia Restaurant described as outstanding and internationally varied, and staff who are repeatedly described as extremely friendly and attentive, often checking in on how a stay is going. A free shuttle to the Monkey Forest and central Ubud rounds out the practical amenities. The main watchout is dining variety: as a smaller, quieter resort, guests note there aren't a large number of dinner options on-site, so some venture into Ubud town for evening meals. For travelers seeking a wellness-oriented, nature-immersed base near Ubud rather than a large-scale resort, it's a well-reviewed choice.

faqs.question: Does The Westin Resort & Spa Ubud, Bali offer a shuttle to central Ubud?
faqs.answer: Yes -- the resort provides a free shuttle to central Ubud and the Monkey Forest, useful given its location in Singakerta on Ubud's outskirts rather than directly in the town center.

faqs.question: Are there enough dinner options at The Westin Resort & Spa Ubud, Bali?
faqs.answer: On-site dinner options are more limited than at a large full-service resort, according to guest reviews, so some travelers use the free shuttle to eat in Ubud town in the evenings.

reviews.summary: First-hand family stay in a Family Suite booked with Marriott Bonvoy points. Covers the jungle location, Titanium elite upgrade, dining, pools, kids' club, spa and yoga pavilion; rated 10/10.
